mapper.select: SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(word_count), 0) AS words, COALESCE(SUM(chapter_count), 0) AS chapters FROM t_novel WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(word_count), 0) AS words, 0 AS chapters FROM t_chapter WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
SELECT AS day, COUNT(*) AS chapters, COALESCE(SUM(word_count), 0) AS words FROM t_chapter WHERE deleted = 0 AND updated_at >= #{from} GROUP BY
SELECT AS day, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS tokens FROM t_ai_usage WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY
SELECT scene AS scene, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS tokens FROM t_ai_usage WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY scene ORDER BY tokens DESC, calls DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{todayStart} THEN total_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayTokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{todayStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayCalls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{todayStart} THEN prompt_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayPromptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{todayStart} THEN completion_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayCompletionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{todayStart} AND success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayFailed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{monthStart} THEN total_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthTokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{monthStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthCalls, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, MAX(created_at) AS lastCalledAt FROM t_ai_usage
